finding: A prior merge left submission_writer importing an API absent from validate.py; several tests could not import.
action: The shared validate/writer API was reconciled; current project tests are run below and reported in the session summary.

finding: Legacy tests referenced sibling package names and a previous uniqueness API.
action: Tests and shared uniqueness helpers now use the gems61 package; regression cases cover exact 70% versus 71% raw overlap, the independent rho stop rule, and incomplete-registry clearance.

finding: Multiple historical data layouts (data/official, data/bridge, data/raw) are used by different scripts; ignored link directories can make a fresh clone fail.
action: prepare_data.py documents and recreates the data links; data source/hash provenance remains in evidence/data_preparation.json.

finding: A full-catalogue-pruned raster loses dots near segments subsequently hidden by a catalogue holdout, making its holdout result artificially low.
action: H61-G hides whole segments and derives/prunes catalogue features only from visible faults. Registry rasters are shown with a construction-bias caveat.

finding: A prior near-blanket raster has a 95.8182% eligible-area base rate. H61-G's 40,000 dots have 98.5925% raw one-sided 3-px overlap (39,437 dots) with it, far above the literal >70% stop rule, despite Jaccard 0.007481 and rho +0.001844.
action: The raw overlap is the gate; Jaccard/base rate are diagnostic only. H61-G is logged DUPLICATE — DO NOT SUBMIT. The updated pipeline now gates before writer and after re-reading a newly written TIFF; this historical raster was instead checked by the separate `unique` audit stage.

finding: The fetched list contains 21 explicitly named sibling rasters; accessible local downloads add 6. Neither proves completeness of all earlier files or the organizer-side registry.
action: uniqueness reports full_registry_coverage=false and fails closed; no global uniqueness claim is made.

finding: docs/data/registry.json is a historical snapshot generated by an earlier builder from reports/*.json, not evidence of H61-G's complete submission registry.
action: Provenance is recorded in evidence/registry_snapshot_provenance.json; current audit uses the fetched finite list plus accessible project downloads.

finding: The 2026-10-11 public leaderboard showed account extradr19 at 0.2778/#23, but no portal receipt or artifact hash maps that row to H33-2-B2.
action: Keep the account row ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED; treat the file association as OWNER-REPORTED/unverified. Public sibling page labels H33-2-B2 UNSCORED.

finding: An archived prior TIFF has 7,111,787 NaNs, all outside the official sample footprint; finite cells are [0,1], but a whole-raster range/finiteness check fails.
action: Raw audit saved at evidence/prior_range_error_audit.json. This plausibly explains the earlier [0,1] message, but no receipt/hash confirms that exact file was historically rejected. New validator checks the full raster.

finding: Intrabasement lithologic density contrasts can produce gravity edges that resemble basement relief; no independent density/lithology evidence was used to discriminate them.
action: Explicitly unresolved in method and run card; H61-H/H61-J remain hypotheses, not conclusions.

finding: Historical README/site text called H61-G unique and safe to upload before the literal raw-overlap check was recomputed.
action: Current site and run card mark it FORMAT-VALID but DUPLICATE / audit-only / do not submit; the TIFF is not cleared.

finding: Undamped Oldenburg iteration diverges on the isostatic residual.
action: Damped, band-limited inversion is documented; value remains model-dependent.

finding: 3×3 raster ribbons scored 0.0216 versus 0.0465 for dots under the same H61-G fold cells; metric penalizes extra positive pixels.
action: Dots are retained for this internal candidate; the H61-G artifact is nevertheless blocked by uniqueness.

finding: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM is an official free/public-domain source, but exact target-footprint tile availability was not checked.
action: H61-L is conditional only; no availability or performance claim until official tile IDs, dates, CRS and hashes are checked.

finding: Direct DrivenData/USGS endpoints are not reachable from this sandbox; competition raster inputs came from a hash-pinned public bridge.
action: Source class is documented in evidence/data_preparation.json; bridge bytes are not an organizer receipt.

finding: H61-G run card records 3/3 experiments used; the research budget is exhausted.
action: No experiment, candidate rebuild, slot use, or organizer score claim was made; further science requires a new authorized run card/scope.
